_note: The base kits (docs/plans/phases/rebuild-phase2-heroes-enemies.md, section 3; docs/plans/design/rebuild-heroes.md, sections 4 and 6-8). Heroes act in this order in a fight. Stats and mana are the design's; cooldowns, Mend's heal, and Hearthguard's Shield are first numbers for step 7 to tune.
name: Brannoc of the Hearthwatch
title: the warden

basic_attack.name: Shield Bash
basic_attack.text: Bashes the enemy in front of him.

signature._note: Taunts enemies within 2 hexes for Taunt's own 3s. The DEF is the passive of the same name below: it holds while any enemy is taunted by him.
signature.name: Hold the Line
signature.text: Taunts every enemy within 2 hexes of him, so they turn on him instead.

passives.name: Hold the Line
passives.text: His DEF is 1.5 times as high while any enemy is taunted by him.

passives.name: Hearthguard
passives.text: The first ally to fall low on HP gets a Shield from him, once a fight.
